messages:
Olia: Idea dump: propose a layered canary controller where local "sentinels" handle immediate safety (seconds) and a thin central "auditor" issues short-lived promotion tokens for state changes beyond a TTL. Goal: keep fast protection while ensuring a single source of truth for STABLE.

Devin: Nice. Two calls out: per-tenant fairness and cache warming. Sentinels need to be tenant-aware so we don't punish other tenants on the same node.

marco-bot: deploy 6162626262: canary 'v9-edge' -> 1% at 11:04 UTC. Observability hooks created. :rocket:

Priya: Warming plan: micro-shadow 0.15% to warm KV and device kernels. Mirror should tag requests so they're excluded from quota and from SLA math. Also, skip very long generations to keep cost sane.

Hector: Fallback ladder suggestion: (1) exact prefix cache (2) tenant-pinned variant (3) local quantized variant (q4) (4) hosted fallback. Each step emits reason_code and tenant tag.

Yuna: Observers/sentinels can act for up to 20s (fast bailout). If action continues -> request audit token. Auditor validates fused signals (latency, error-rate, quality probe delta) before minting token.

Olia: Signal fusion example: score = 0.5*normalized_latency + 0.3*error_rate_delta + 0.2*quality_delta. If score > threshold -> emergency_spill. Quality delta measured by small eval set replay every 5-10m.

Devin: Split-brain: when auditor unreachable, sentinels enter DEGRADED mode: reduce allowed spill_pct by 10x, disable promotions to STABLE, keep only local bailouts. Once auditor returns, it reconciles leases and can persist rollback/stable decisions.

Priya: Telemetry contract: emit small record per decision: tenant, variant_from, variant_to, reason_code, signal_vector, sample_output_hash. No raw outputs. Also emit a compact "canary_score" used by auditor.

Hector: Ops playbook snippet: EMERGENCY_SPILL -> pause rollout, scale variant down, route affected tenants to pinned variant, capture recent traces and cache keys, page oncall with tenant impact + suggested rollback reason.

Yuna: Per-tenant policy table: fallback_preference, max_spill_pct, emergency_cutoff, pinned_variant. Router should resolve tenant locally and apply policy without remote roundtrip.

Olia: Tests: chaos job killing auditor mid-rollout, noisy-tenant flood, and stale-cache where shadow didn't prefill. Also include a regression harness that replays eval prompts against both variants every 10m.

Devin: Implementation note: make audit tokens short-lived (e.g., 60s) and lease-based. Tokens should include the fused-signal snapshot the auditor used so reconcilers can later explain decisions.

Priya: One more: add cooldown/hysteresis after any spill: block promotions for X minutes and require two successive good audit tokens before resuming ramp to avoid flip-flop.

Olia: I'll draft a compact RFC follow-up with state-machine, token flow diagram, tenant policy schema, and ops runbook excerpt. Anyone want to coauthor?

Hector: I'll take telemetry and runbook.

Yuna: I'll prototype sentinel lease logic and the shadow filter.

Devin: I'll sketch the auditor fusion function and PromQL examples.

Olia: Great, thanks all :thumbsup:
